model.title: Veteran Infection Prevention Act
model.meta: Veterans' Affairs Committee · Rep. Jennifer Kiggans (R-VA)

summary.text: The bill would require that, with some exceptions for entry-level jobs, people appointed as sterile processing technicians at the Veterans Health Administration must earn a certification from an accredited training institution within two years of their appointment. It would apply this requirement to current employees 18 months after the bill is enacted, and would give those current employees without certification a scholarship to earn it, with a one-day period of obligated service starting when they receive the certification. The certification requirement would end on September 30, 2028. The bill would also extend a limit on certain pension payments under federal veterans law, changing the date in that provision from January 31, 2033 to September 30, 2034.
